sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body: 'Santa's Secret Gift' is an arcade game that requires the player to navigate a festive holiday-themed world, collecting gifts while avoiding obstacles. The game's mechanics are simple yet challenging, making it accessible to players of all ages. The core gameplay revolves around the use of the super gift box, which can be thrown in any direction to teleport Santa to its location. This mechanic allows for creative problem-solving and strategic thinking, making the game both fun and engaging. The game also features doors that can be passed through using the down arrow key, adding an extra layer of complexity to the gameplay.
